subject: MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement next steps (Ariba/Coupa setup, W-9, banking)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bates <laura.bates@acmeindustries.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP draft and vendor onboarding checklist (follow-up)

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the call this morning - great to meet you and the Acme team. Attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed, plus a focused vendor onboarding/procurement checklist for Ariba/Coupa setup, vendor forms, W-9 submission, and banking details.

High-level proposed milestones:
- Week 0: Finalize MAP & signatures (Owner: Camila)
- Week 1: Procurement collects vendor forms + W-9 (Owner: Acme Procurement)
- Week 2: Ariba/Coupa vendor setup + banking verification (Owner: Acme Procurement / Redwood Finance)
- Week 3: Test integration & pilot traffic (Owner: Redwood + Acme Dev)
- Target close: 2026-12-17

Dependencies we flagged on the call: Ariba/Coupa onboarding lead time (procurement queue), internal vendor validation (banking + W-9), and any additional security questionnaires. I've attached the MAP draft and a stub W-9 for reference.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Please confirm procurement contact who will own Ariba/Coupa setup and vendor forms.
2) Let us know if Acme needs a Redwood supplier profile (we can provide the information package).
3) If the target close date looks off, propose alternatives and we'll adjust the MAP.

Happy to hop on a quick handoff call with procurement if helpful - Marissa will join from our side.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: MAP_Draft_v2.pdf, W-9_Acme.pdf

From: Laura Bates <laura.bates@acmeindustries.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeindustries.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and vendor onboarding checklist (follow-up)

Thanks Camila - appreciate the recap and the MAP draft. A few quick items from procurement: 

- We use Coupa; please confirm whether Redwood can be added as a supplier in Coupa or if you prefer Ariba. We primarily onboard via Coupa punchout + supplier setup.
- Procurement will need our vendor profile packet (company address, tax ID, remit-to banking details). Do you have a standard Redwood vendor packet we can fill out?
- W-9 looks good, but procurement requires a signed copy (PDF). Can you send a signed W-9 and a copy of the Redwood bank verification?
- Lead time: our Coupa team is currently processing vendor requests with a 7-10 business day SLAT once they have complete docs.

I'm looping in procurement (procurement@acmeindustries.com) - I'm the internal sponsor and will route the packet. We're comfortable with the proposed milestones but will need to align the target close with the Coupa lead time.

Can you provide the signed W-9 and vendor packet by EOD 11/30?

Best,
Laura Bates
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Acme Industries
laura.bates@acmeindustries.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeindustries.com>, Laura Bates <laura.bates@acmeindustries.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and vendor onboarding checklist (follow-up)

Hi Laura / Acme procurement team -

Thanks for the details. Quick update and proposed owners (mirrors MAP):

- Supplier platform: Redwood supports both Ariba and Coupa; we can be added as a Coupa supplier. Owner: Acme Procurement (please send supplier invitation to vendors@redwoodinference.com).
- Vendor packet: Attached is Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf (it includes company address, tax ID, remit-to banking instructions, and a contact for bank verification). Owner: Camila (to provide), action: fill and return.
- W-9: Attached is a signed W-9 (W-9_Acme.pdf was a stub earlier; the signed one is attached here). Owner: Redwood (attached).
- Banking verification: Rafael from Redwood Finance will provide a bank verification letter if Acme requires it. Rafael - can you confirm what format works for your team (letter vs micro-deposit)?

Proposed updated timeline given Coupa SLAT (7-10 bd):
- 11/30: Redwood sends signed W-9 + vendor packet (Owner: Camila) - DONE (attachments)
- 12/01-12/10: Acme Coupa vendor setup & banking verification (Owner: Acme Procurement)
- 12/13-12/16: Integration test & pilot (Owner: Redwood + Acme Dev)
- Target close: 2026-12-17 (contingent on Coupa completion)

Dependencies: complete vendor packet + signed W-9, successful banking verification, and a procurement invitation sent to vendors@redwoodinference.com.

Rafael - tagging you for bank verification. Marissa - looping you for the handoff and any billing/PO questions.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf, Signed_W-9_Redwood.pdf

From: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeindustries.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bates <laura.bates@acmeindustries.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T15:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and vendor onboarding checklist (follow-up)

Hi Camila / Laura,

Thanks - procurement confirmed they received the vendor packet and signed W-9. We have submitted the Coupa supplier request; expected processing window is 7 business days from today (target completion 2026-12-09). We will reach back if any additional banking docs are required (micro-deposit preferred).

Action items captured:
- Acme: processing in Coupa (Owner: Acme Procurement)
- Redwood: Rafael to provide bank verification via micro-deposit if needed (Owner: Rafael Mendes)
- Both: Schedule integration test week of 12/13 (Owner: Camila + Acme Dev)

Will update the HubSpot deal (ACME-2026-027) as things progress.

Regards,
Acme Procurement
procurement@acmeindustries.com
